title: A fast-Cauchy sequence of sets converges locally in measure to its liminf
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and G_j ⊆ ℝⁿ (j ∈ ℕ) be Borel sets with L((G_{i+1} Δ G_i) ∩ B_{i+1}(0)) ≤ 2^{−i} for every i ∈ ℕ. Then there is a Borel set F₀ ⊆ ℝⁿ such that L((G_j Δ F₀) ∩ B_R(0)) → 0 as j → ∞ for every R ∈ ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Gs : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Gs j)) → (∀ i : ℕ, volume (symmDiff (Gs (i + 1)) (Gs i) ∩ ball (0 : Euclid n) ((i : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ i) → ∃ F₀ : Set (Euclid n), MeasurableSet F₀ ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j => volume (symmDiff (Gs j) F₀ ∩ ball (0 : Euclid n) R)) atTop (𝓝 0)
